target.statement: DualEraser 1.3B achieves 32.21 dB PSNR on the ROSE Benchmark (and the 5B variant reaches 33.33 dB, a 2.16 dB gain over SVOR), demonstrating state-of-the-art joint object-and-effect removal.

compute.basis: The target requires reproducing a two-stage training pipeline for a Wan2.2 5B / Wan2.1 1.3B video diffusion model on 60k VOR + 17k ROSE video pairs, trained with batch size 2 across 16 A100 GPUs; no code, weights, or configs are linked, so even the 1.3B variant cannot be fully reproduced from scratch on an 8-core/16 GB CPU laptop within hours.

blockers: No code or model weights released (the PDF link list is empty)
Training uses 16 A100 GPUs and 60k+17k video pairs
Requires the Wan2.2 5B / Wan2.1 1.3B base models and Qwen3-VL 8B for Bipartite Text prompt generation
Full pipeline includes two-stage MoE-style training of Locator and Preserver plus LD-CFG, which is infeasible on a CPU-only laptop
Benchmark evaluation depends on the trained DualEraser checkpoints, which are not provided
title: DualEraser: Joint Video Object and Effect Removal via Balanced Text-Mask Guidance and Decoupled Locator-Preserver
